results.text: Ibuprofen-Induced Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis: Report of a Fatal Case. Ibuprofen is a widely used and easily accessible medication that belongs to the nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug class. Its most common adverse effects are gastrointestinal. However, there are a few reported cases of fatal side effects.
